title: An agent's image is a source in the essay's references, as sources already work

sections.name: words
sections.label: Owner, 2026-11-24
sections.content: A - This should work just like it already does.

sections.name: context
sections.content: Answer to the open question of semanticops.com#71 / srs-web#826: where does an image an agent adds live, so it is linked to the essay without being placed? Option A, as put to the owner: a source record in the essay's references container, with the image attached; agents already write there, so the guard does not change. The other options were: linked to the essay record (B), an unplaced image paragraph (C), the file alone (D). Refines vignette 1392d20e.
